newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wackenhut Corrections cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wackenhut Corrections cut to hold.

text.p: -- Stephens Inc analyst Jim Janesky said he cut Wackenhut Corrections Corp's rating from a buy to a hold.
-- Janesky said the rate move was based on a decision by the New Mexico legislature to revise the terms of its proposed plan to privatize 3,400 beds with Wackenhut.
-- He said he believes the project will now include 2,400 beds instead of 3,400 and whether the facilities will be managed by the private sector still must be negotiated.

-- The decision "and our questions concerning the company's short term and long term profit margins could create a level of uncertainty that could limit the upside potential of WHC's stock price," he said in a research statement.
